summary:
Reincarnation of Apollo is an open world Mars survival and colony management simulation designed for web and mobile browsers. It addresses the challenge of making authentic space science accessible by translating complex aerospace engineering into engaging, kid-friendly gameplay. Rather than oversimplifying survival, the game immerses players in real environmental trade offs, balancing solar collection with night time battery reserves, recycling water to generate oxygen, shielding crew from solar radiation, and driving an upgradeable rover across Martian terrain to scan geological sites.

This project is important because traditional STEM curricula often present space exploration as abstract theory or punishing math. By pairing grounded planetary physics with interactive guidance, natural events, and helpful feedback, the game turns engineering failures into constructive learning moments. It empowers young astronauts to think like real mission commanders fostering systems literacy, scientific curiosity, and the problem solving mindset needed for humanity's next giant leap.
details:
In Reincarnation of Apollo the player plays the role of a junior astronaut attempting to place mankind on Mars. The player will play through an exciting survival and base building story. On this beautiful harsh world of Mars you must manage resources, survive dangerous situations and explore using rovers. Your objective as commander is to turn this lifeless wasteland into a thriving colony on Mars, keeping your crew safe from any dangers. This game is perfect for those who enjoy strategy base building games, space exploration and a survival sci-fi experience.

Reincarnation of Apollo is a 3D interactive open world, survival and colony management simulator set on Mars which aims to educate students and aspiring young astronauts on aerospace engineering and planet science. It was created using a variety of technologies including TypeScript, React 19, React Three Fiber (Three.js), Tailwind CSS, Vite and TanStack. The game can be run within your web browser on platforms like phone, tablet, desktop computer and uses WebGL for hardware acceleration. The player must manage their closed loop life support system on Mars. This includes gathering energy during the day from the sun, storing it in batteries during the night and using electrolysis to create breathable oxygen from water. The player will also upgrade their rover to explore a 3D environment to collect samples of minerals, scanning for anomalies and completing objectives. The creativity behind the project is taking complex aerospace data and engineering compromises from NASA and turning them into an easy to understand and fun game. This project aims to increase interest in STEM as well as showing how engineering can be a positive learning experience. Throughout development we have focused on making the game easy to play. Ensuring that it works well on multiple devices with our custom controls. We have ensured that there are multiple difficulty levels, interactive tutorials, relaxing background music and spaced out disasters (dust storms and solar radiation). The game is based around real science and human activity giving an inspiring and easy way to learn about human space exploration.
